KE.title: TELUS Digital AI Community: Personalized Internet Assessor, Kenya
KE.note: TELUS lists an Internet Assessor role for Kenya starting 23 September 2026. It requires living in Kenya for the last 5 years, plus a smartphone and a personal computer.

source.title: TELUS Digital AI Community company description

availability.note: TELUS Digital describes a global AI Community but publishes no country list we could find. Kenya is marked accepted from a live TELUS job listing. Other African countries are unclear until checked on a live listing.

items.text: The AI Community works across more than 500 languages and dialects, and many roles are aimed at people with strong language skills.
Reported roles include internet rater (checking search results), map data analyst, content evaluator and transcription.
Pay is reported to be monthly by direct deposit, PayPal or Payoneer depending on your country, with a minimum payout of roughly 20 to 50 US dollars.
